title: Calls in the form of 'suspend {}' are deprecated because 'suspend' in this context will have the meaning of a modifier. Surround the lambda with parentheses: 'suspend({ ... })'.
message_templates: Calls in the form of 'suspend {}' are deprecated because 'suspend' in this context will have the meaning of a modifier. Surround the lambda with parentheses: 'suspend({ ... })'.

title: Calls in the form of 'suspend fun' are deprecated because 'suspend' in the context will have the meaning of a modifier. Surround the argument of the call with parentheses: 'suspend(fun() { ... })'. See https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KT-49264.
message_templates: Calls in the form of 'suspend fun' are deprecated because 'suspend' in the context will have the meaning of a modifier. Surround the argument of the call with parentheses: 'suspend(fun() { ... })'. See https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KT-49264

title: Modifiers are not in the correct order.
summary: Consider to reorder these modifiers. It is in the style rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.0.0.
